## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: dispatch-request and dispatch-result schemas exist under openspec/schemas...

The system SHALL ensure that dispatch-request and dispatch-result schemas exist under openspec/schemas and execution.py and orchestrator.py validate against them with existing fixtures passing.

#### Scenario: dispatch-request and dispatch-result schemas exist under openspec/schemas...

WHEN `dispatch-contract` is implemented
THEN dispatch-request and dispatch-result schemas exist under openspec/schemas and execution.py and orchestrator.py validate against them with existing fixtures passing.

### Requirement: runner.py emit-result produces a schema-valid result for every terminal and...

The system SHALL ensure that runner.py emit-result produces a schema-valid result for every terminal and parked loop-state shape, verified end to end.

#### Scenario: runner.py emit-result produces a schema-valid result for every terminal and...

WHEN `dispatch-contract` is implemented
THEN runner.py emit-result produces a schema-valid result for every terminal and parked loop-state shape, verified end to end.

### Requirement: A closure contract test fails when any schema-permitted parked kind/gate...

The system SHALL ensure that a closure contract test fails when any schema-permitted parked kind/gate combination lacks a supervisor answer or resume path.

#### Scenario: A closure contract test fails when any schema-permitted parked kind/gate...

WHEN `dispatch-contract` is implemented
THEN A closure contract test fails when any schema-permitted parked kind/gate combination lacks a supervisor answer or resume path.

### Requirement: A posture-derived gate block clears on resume after a posture change while a...

The system SHALL ensure that a posture-derived gate block clears on resume after a posture change while a human rejection does not.

#### Scenario: A posture-derived gate block clears on resume after a posture change while a...

WHEN `dispatch-contract` is implemented
THEN A posture-derived gate block clears on resume after a posture change while a human rejection does not.

### Requirement: execution_profile, review_requirements, and degradations[] are carried end...

The system SHALL ensure that execution_profile, review_requirements, and degradations[] are carried end to end, and permission_blocked and capability_unavailable parks are routed to the operator as single escalations.

#### Scenario: execution_profile, review_requirements, and degradations[] are carried end...

WHEN `dispatch-contract` is implemented
THEN execution_profile, review_requirements, and degradations[] are carried end to end, and permission_blocked and capability_unavailable parks are routed to the operator as single escalations.
